# Personal-use fonts

These handwriting fonts are free for personal use only and are not licensed for commercial use or redistribution:

- Autography by Hendra Pratama (demo, personal use only)
- Brother Signature by Hendra Pratama
- Amsterdam by Lettersiro (personal use only, no numbers in the free version)
- Always Classy by Blankids Studio

They stay the property of their designers. Buy a commercial license from the designer before using them for anything other than personal projects.

The font files are not committed to git (see `.gitignore`). Expected file names: `autography.otf`, `brother-signature.otf`, `amsterdam.ttf`, `always-classy.ttf`.
